question: A flop opens to $30 million; each later weekend takes 40% of the previous one. All weekends together, in millions of dollars?
move: When each step keeps a fixed share, the first step is most of the total.
trap: Expecting a long tail that keeps adding, when each weekend shrinks.
hint: A total that keeps a fixed fraction each time adds up to the first term divided by what is lost.
steps: The weekends run 30, 12, 4.8, 1.9 and so on.
Each keeps 0.4 of the last, so the total is 30 / (1 - 0.4).
reference: Vogel, Entertainment Industry Economics: A Guide for Financial Analysis, 9th edition, Cambridge University Press, 2015
